maria: Quick ping — docs PR queue has 3 blocked PRs needing reviewers. Can someone pick up? PRs: #1347 (SDK snippet), #1350 (migration guide link fix), #1352 (examples).
ben: I can take #1347 and #1352, but need a quick review window this afternoon.
jordan: I can review #1350 (link fix) — small.
maria: Awesome. @ben can you run the preview for the SDK snippets after local build? We had flakiness last time.
ben: Yep. Running `yarn docs:preview pr/1347` now — will paste preview link once up.
docs-preview-bot: Preview for PR #1347 ready: https://deploy.preview.redwood-inference/s/preview/1347
lee: Heads-up — I'm on reviewer rotation today but can help triage CI failures if any.
ben: Preview looks fine, snippet formatting cleaned. Filing a tiny follow-up fix for one code fence.
maria: Great. @jordan can you merge #1350 after you confirm the Netlify preview?
jordan: Confirmed, Netlify preview looks good. Merging now — will watch CI.
docs-preview-bot: PR #1350 merged by jordan. Deployment started.
maria: After merge, we still have capacity gap for one reviewer tomorrow morning (PST) — who can cover the rotation?
lee: I can swap tomorrow morning (PST) with @ben — ben, you okay with taking my afternoon slot? :+1:
ben: Yep, fine with swap. I'll take afternoon review shift tomorrow.
maria: Thanks everyone. Filing a quick note in the docs rotation board to reflect the swap.
ben: Also leaving a short checklist in the PRs about preview flakiness steps: `npm run build:docs` then `yarn docs:preview`.
maria: Perfect. Closing thread.
